t:3ab7013cf21551f2.title: Same-root prayer owner death and revival preserve the old reservation through every Worker restart
t:3ab7013cf21551f2.bindingNote: Actual same-root multi-target death, Lia prayer reservation, death-gift cancellation refill and FuSen revival preserve the old ownerLifeId and discard once after the root; no post-revival inheritance.
